notes: EXAMPLE of a REPOSITORY's own registration. Copy to .security/policy-registration.json on the protected default branch, put that path under CODEOWNERS, and replace every value. It is read from the default branch, never from a pull request. Scopes here name only environment_tier: this file IS the repository level, above everything the central register (the kit's policy/policy-registration.json) says for this repository's org, team and product. It may TIGHTEN, never soften. With no registration anywhere the kit default applies: crawl at every tier, only secrets block.
